name: The Timber Ridge Tavern
tagline: Cold Beer. Hot Food. Ride Right In.
about: The Timber Ridge Tavern is a trailside bar and grill on the edge of town, right off the county trail. We serve hand-pattied burgers, wings, pizza and ice cold beer, with live music on weekends. Stop in after a ride, bring the whole crew, and we will take care of you.

ride.title: Ride Right Up to the Door
ride.text: Timber Ridge sits right off the county trail. Park out front, grab a cold one and refuel before you head back out.
points: Room out front for bikes, ATVs and sleds
Full bar and kitchen, open till 1am Fri and Sat

feature.title: The Ridge Burger
feature.desc: Two hand-smashed patties, smoked cheddar, house bacon jam and a pile of crispy onions on a toasted brioche bun. The one everybody orders twice.
